_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description: The directory picker opens from the directory control, pins its footer, and handles nested Escape. On this phone-sized screen "the directory control" is in the overflow menu: when ".chat-overflow-popover" is not visible, first click the header's button with aria-label exactly "More options"; the control is then the button in ".chat-overflow-popover" whose accessible name starts with "Directory". The picker is ".modal.directory-picker-modal"; its footer is its ".modal-footer". {{SMALL}} is a small directory named "e2e". 1. Navigate to /new. 2. The directory control should be visible; click it. 3. The picker should be visible, ".modal-title" should have exactly the text "Select Directory", and the element with role="dialog" whose accessible name (the text of the element its aria-labelledby names) is "Select Directory" should have aria-modal="true" (pick it by name: the overflow menu is also a dialog and may still be leaving). 4. Fill the picker's ".directory-picker-input" with "{{SMALL}}/"; ".directory-picker-current-path" should then contain "e2e". 5. The footer's buttons named "Select" and "Cancel" should be visible. 6. Click the footer's "New Folder" button: ".directory-picker-create-input" should be visible. 7. With that create input focused, press Escape: there should be no ".directory-picker-create-input" (count 0), and the picker should still be visible. 8. Press Escape again: the picker count should become 0. 9. Click the directory control again (reopening the overflow menu if needed): the picker should be visible. 10. Click the footer's "Cancel" button: the picker count should become 0.

steps.expression: const dialogs = [...document.querySelectorAll('[role=dialog]')]; const selectDir = dialogs.find(d => { const id = d.getAttribute('aria-labelledby'); const el = id ? document.getElementById(id) : null; return el?.textContent?.trim() === 'Select Directory'; }); selectDir?.getAttribute('aria-modal')
